methods.name: scanMediaFiles
methods.summary:
Scans newly created or downloaded media files to make them available to other
Android media providers, such as the Gallery.
methods.description:
Android scans media files for inclusion in the Gallery and other media providers.
Use this method to force an immediate scan of particular files, such as
newly-created or downloaded resources.
    
See [MediaScannerConnection in the Android API Reference](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/media/MediaScannerConnection.html).

parameters.name: paths
parameters.summary: Array of paths to the files you want to scan.

parameters.name: mimeTypes
parameters.summary:
Array of MIME types for the files in the paths parameter. If `null`, MIME type will 
be inferred from the file names.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: Function to call when each file is done being scanned.

inlined.name: MediaScannerResponse
inlined.summary: Simple object passed to the [scanMediaFiles](api:Titanium.Media.Android#scanMediaFiles) callback.
inlined.description: The callback is called once per scanned file.

properties.name: path
properties.summary: Path to the media file that was scanned.

properties.name: uri
properties.summary:
URI to the file if it was scanned and added to the media library, or `null`
if the file was not added.

methods.name: setSystemWallpaper
methods.description:
The image to use as the wallpaper must be passed as a [Titanium.Blob](api:Titanium.Blob). You can
create a `Blob` from an image file by calling [File.read](api:Titanium.Filesystem.File#read). 
You can also use the [Titanium.Media.openPhotoGallery](api:Titanium.Media#openPhotoGallery) 
or [Titanium.Media.showCamera](api:Titanium.Media#showCamera) methods to allow users to select an existing photo
or take a new one.

parameters.name: image
parameters.summary: Image to use as the wallpaper, as a `Blob` object.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.summary:
If `true`, the image is scaled to fit the width of the system wallpaper. If
`false`, the image is not scaled.
